test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

He told me that he would have finished the project by the following day.

options.text: "I would finish the project," he said to me tomorrow.
"I will finish the project by the next day," he said to me.
"I have finished the project by tomorrow," he said to me
"I will have finished the project by tomorrow," he said to me.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He told me that he would have finished the project by the following day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"He would have finished the project by the following day" becomes "I will have finished the project by tomorrow"**
